data.written: 2026-10-13, pin 8 fix, job 1 of 2 (FAILURE_LOG F46/F47 method, this review): pin 8 v7's v2_0r (run 20261013_190541; pose gate pass, identity 0.71) has his face, beard, build, chain, cat, phone and room, but the head came back with the pin man's straight dark swept hair and heavy bangs, not his tight curls: checklist items 19 and 28 fail (the user-approved 2026-10-01 best.jpg has the curls). As with pin 14's head (F45/F46: a replicate head swap came back too large; the region edit keeps the head's size, turn and place), the head is changed in place: the crop of the head (picture box 280-545 x 70-340 of the 768x1376 v2_0r, sent at 4x, 1060x1080) goes to Gemini, and tools/region_edit.py pastes back only the hair area (a polygon traced on the pin man's hair read at 3x, grown 25-45 px up and out so that his taller curls have room over the wall, its lower edge at y 246-250, above the brows at y 255+; the ear, the face, the beard, the phone and the cat are outside it; an 8 px ramp inside its edge and a blur of 5). The crop ends at y 340 where the phone begins, so the phone, his fingers and the cat are not in it. References for his hair only: the head of the 2026-10-01 approved best.jpg (his curls, the same bowed look down at the phone) and his front photo IMG_6858's hair. The same v2_0r receives the janeu fix (job 2, the chest) afterwards: the two areas do not overlap. No earring or other jewellery shows on the head, so none is named.
